description: Render one document and return it in the result: its pages as images (as many as fit; from_page shows the rest), the ground truth, the PDF's SHA-256 and page count, and the PDF itself when include_pdf is set and it fits within the size limit. No file is saved. Every page carries specimen markers.

also.description: 835: also write the X12 835 remittance of the same claims (msn, ppo-eob and hmo-eob only), as a file in the workspace or as text in the result

from_page.description: first page to return as an image (default 1)

include_pdf.description: also return the PDF itself, embedded in the result; it counts toward the same size limit as the page images and is left out, with a note, when it alone is over it

layout_variant.description: Optional. A layout variant id from this document type's published list, or seeded to pick one from the seed. Applies only to itemized-bill, ppo-eob and hmo-eob. Leave it out for the standard layout, unchanged. The answer key records which variant was used.

preview.description: pages returned as images: none, the first (from from_page), or all from from_page on, as many as fit in one result (default all)

seed.description: any short string (letters, digits, . _ -); the same seed always gives the same document

type.description: document type: msn, itemized-bill, ppo-eob, hmo-eob

name: render_document
title: Render a document to PDF
